notes.title: LumenTale: Memories of Trey | Beehive Studios & Team17 Partnership Announcement
notes.content:
We're very excited to announce that we've partnered with Team17 to publish our upcoming monster collector RPG, LumenTale: Memories of Trey!

Are you ready to embark on an adventure in a land of mystical creatures and lost memories? Discover the secrets of Talea in LumenTale: Memories of Trey!

Catch Animon
Test your skills with the Holoken and catch Animon in the field to recruit them to your party or initiate an incredible and exciting battle against them to prove your mettle!

Battles
Engage in thrilling 1v1 duels or team up for epic 4v4 showdowns with your party in battle. Each Animon has strengths and weaknesses for you to uncover, so use them to your advantage.

Trading
With up to 3 different ways to trade your Animon, you can effortlessly  complete your collection and build the perfect battle team.

Cook and Craft
While on your adventure, be sure to take a rest at the Fountain, where you’ll be able to craft useful items and cook delicious food!

The Anispace
The Anispace is a place that exists and doesn’t exist at the same time. A space detached from the world as we know it. Here is where you’ll find your Animon after you capture them and where you’ll be able to train your Animon for battle.
